notes: Base unit ships with 8 empty modular slots (mic/line, digital, output, control-expansion, paging, etc. modules sold separately - e.g. D-001T/D-001R dual mic-line input, T-001T dual output, C-001T control I/O - each 2-channel, removable terminal-block/euroblock connectors). Those slot-based ports are optional accessories, not fixed physical I/O of this SKU, so they are omitted from the port list above; only the amplifier's built-in fixed connectors are listed. No Ethernet/RJ45 network port is documented on this model. Control I/O, control inputs, and remote-volume connections share a single 14-pin removable terminal block per TOA's spec sheet but are logically distinct circuits, so they are listed as separate logical ports. Speaker outputs modeled as euroblock (closest listed id) since the connector is TOA's proprietary 4-pin removable terminal block, not a raw bare-wire euroblock -- closest available option per the port model constraints. AC input is 120V/60Hz (US A-9120DHM2CU variant); other regional SKUs (e.g. 230V EU/UK) may use a different mains voltage but the same IEC inlet. No bandwidth-graded connectors present (no HDMI/SDI/DP/USB/Ethernet), so no grade fields are set. Cross-checked against TOA Canada mirror site and multiple retailer listings (B&H, Markertek, Dale Pro Audio, Adorama) which corroborate the modular architecture, dimensions (2U, 420 x 107.6 x 395 mm), and connector types.
